case_level_notes: Primary defect: CRA exceeded the 30-day reinvestigation deadline (38 days) with no qualifying extension since no additional consumer information was provided during the initial 30 days.

determinations.rationale: No consumer statement was filed; not applicable.
CRA reviewed all consumer info, considered primary documents, compared furnisher response and own file per defaults.
Furnisher notified within 2 business days, within the 5 business day limit, with relevant info forwarded.
Valid dispute received directly by CRA with all required elements; no frivolous termination.
Reinvestigation completed in 38 days with no additional info from consumer to trigger 45-day extension; exceeded 30-day deadline.
Consumer disputed accuracy of an item in file with sufficient identification and basis; direct notice to CRA.
No direct furnisher dispute in record; not applicable.
Reinvestigation completed after 38 days without a valid extension, violating the 30-day deadline.
No frivolous termination was made; not applicable.
Furnisher investigated, reviewed info, and reported results within 28 days per defaults.
No identity theft, mixed file, court order, missing documents, date conflicts, or manual review triggers present.
Item verified as accurate per defaults; status recorded as current.
Results notice mailed within 2 business days of completion and otherwise complete with all required disclosures.
